wire.t: Skatabooboo has 54.70 points in Week 7 with nobody left to play. That's below the old league low of 60.44 (DuvalTiliFall, 2025 Week 11), the lowest score in this league's Sleeper history.

In It for Da Penix leads Allen-tents & Purposes 112.32 to 95.58 going into Monday night as a 46.5-point underdog. Shootyeah has 65.82 points on the bench, including Michael Penix Jr. (20.42) and Tre Tucker (21.3).
PickensMyPukaHurts! trails I Pulled My McCaff 100.90 to 133.06 with Dak Prescott and George Pickens still to play Monday night. ChuckJ10 added Tyler Allgeier off waivers Sunday.
Rome Alone leads Skatabooboo 152.12 to 54.70 with CeeDee Lamb still to play. Marco_Polo dropped Deshaun Watson Sunday morning.

McCallyCockin(his butt) leads Your Mom’s Magic Dick 115.24 to 108.28, the closest game of the week, and Bill_Buttlicker still has Dameon Pierce on Monday night. It's the leading By a C-Hair candidate.
ClaytonBigsbi picked up Kyler Murray and Brandin Cooks on Oct. 21. Murray scored 13.9 and Cooks scored 2.3, and Cam Skattebo's 19.1 sat on the bench.
NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson leads The Brown & Bijan Shough 86.42 to 72.52 with Ryan Flournoy and Javonte Williams both still to play Monday night. GeorigaGoocher added Najee Harris Friday.

stories.title: Skatabooboo scores 54.70, the lowest score in league history
stories.dek: ClaytonBigsbi is 0‑7 and has a number nobody else has ever put up.
body: Skatabooboo has 54.70 points in Week 7 and has no one left to play. The old record was DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11. ClaytonBigsbi missed it by 5.74 points.

Kyler Murray gave 13.9 and Alvin Kamara gave 13.2. After that it was Brandin Cooks with 2.3, Xavier Worthy with 4.1, Kendrick Bourne with 3.9 and Pat Freiermuth with 4.0. The Carolina defense scored -3.0. Cam Skattebo scored 19.1 on the bench.

Rome Alone leads 152.12 to 54.70, so that's a 97.42-point gap with CeeDee Lamb still to play Monday night. The previous biggest margin in league history on this site is Allen-tents & Purposes over Skatabooboo in Week 2 (+107.16), so ClaytonBigsbi is safe from the margin record. Barely.
Every other team has at least 72.52 right now, so the Week 7 can is already ClaytonBigsbi's. It would be his third of the year. The official call is Tuesday morning after Monday night.

stories.title: Five games are decided. Three can still flip Monday night.
stories.dek: Dak Prescott, George Pickens, Dameon Pierce, Javonte Williams and CeeDee Lamb are all still on the board.
body: The biggest swing is I Pulled My McCaff (133.06) over PickensMyPukaHurts! (100.90). ChuckJ10 needs 32.16 from Dak Prescott and George Pickens, with Hing1eMcCring13berry's whole lineup done.

The closest one is McCallyCockin(his butt) at 115.24 against Your Mom’s Magic Dick at 108.28, with Bill_Buttlicker holding Dameon Pierce. That's the early leader for the By a C-Hair payout, a winning margin of 6.96.
NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson (86.42) leads The Brown & Bijan Shough (72.52), and both teams have a Dallas player left: Ryan Flournoy for GeorigaGoocher and Javonte Williams for YourMomsDildo.
LetLamarCook is up 110.48 to 94.96 on BrentMayfieldsomepain and is done for the week. DuvalTiliFall improves to 6‑1 unless the scoreboard is lying.

stories.title: In It for Da Penix is beating the best team in the league by 16.74
stories.dek: Shootyeah is a 46.5-point dog and he left 65.82 on the bench. It's working anyway.
body: In It for Da Penix leads Allen-tents & Purposes 112.32 to 95.58. The Sportsbook had it as the biggest line of the week at -46.5, and the dog's only remaining question is Dallas Goedert, who is RedDevil904's last player to play Monday night.

Tre Tucker (21.3), Michael Penix Jr. (20.42) and Braelon Allen's 19.4 are all on the bench of a team that is also named after Penix. The starters were fine too: Tee Higgins had 26.8 and Josh Jacobs had 20.1.
Allen-tents & Purposes is 4‑2 with the best points total in the league. A loss drops it to 4‑3 and puts In It for Da Penix at 2‑5.

stories.title: By a C-Hair has a leader, and it's the commissioner. Obviously.
stories.dek: The smallest winning margin pays. Right now it's McCallyCockin(his butt) by 6.96.
body: The Week 7 side pot goes to the winning team with the smallest margin of victory. As of Monday night, the closest game is McCallyCockin(his butt) over Your Mom’s Magic Dick by 6.96, with Dameon Pierce still to play for Bill_Buttlicker.

Next is NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson over The Brown & Bijan Shough by 13.90, then LetLamarCook over BrentMayfieldsomepain by 15.52 and In It for Da Penix over Allen-tents & Purposes by 16.74. Everything can still change.
It's the same pattern as the first six weeks: tight games decided by the last player on the board. Check back Tuesday for the winner.

feature.title: Week 6: I Pulled My McCaff cooks the co-commish, and LetLamarCook keeps rolling
body: I Pulled My McCaff had the top score of the week, 171.84, and beat Allen-tents & Purposes by 48.24. Christian McCaffrey had 30.7, Malik Nabers had 28.5, and Kenneth Walker III had 27.9. Hing1eMcCring13berry has won three straight and is tied for the best all-play in the league.

LetLamarCook beat The Brown & Bijan Shough 119.48 to 94.84. James Cook III had 24.3 and Isaiah Likely had 23.9. On the other side, YourMomsDildo started Bryce Young over Tyler Shough and left 26.96 on the bench.

McCallyCockin(his butt) beat NailinMaye’sPurdyJohnson 132.80 to 83.36. Drake Maye had 24.8 and Bhayshul Tuten had 24.7. GeorigaGoocher started Juwan Johnson at tight end (zero) and left Kirk Cousins's 19.52 on the bench while Brock Purdy scored 17.36.
In It for Da Penix got its first win, 102.06 to 82.84 over Skatabooboo, with Tre Tucker's 27.7 on the bench. Skatabooboo is still looking for its first.

rumors.t: YourMomsDildo has now paid for DeMario Douglas twice in one week. Douglas has asked whether he should keep a bag packed.

With the Week 7 payout going to the smallest margin of victory, Bill_Buttlicker has asked the league office whether a tie counts as the smallest possible margin. It does not. He asked again an hour later.
Shootyeah paid $21 for Michael Penix Jr. so his team name would finally be accurate. The league office has approved the rebrand.
Hing1eMcCring13berry has asked the league office to confirm his username has the right number of ones and threes. It does. Nobody can spell it, but it does.
tballsmccall has flipped a coin between Baker Mayfield and Bo Nix eleven times this morning. Sources say the coin has asked to be traded to a team with one quarterback.
RedDevil904 is 5-1 in another league and has the most points in this one. He's been asked to stop bragging in two group chats at once.
Bill_Buttlicker has the second-fewest points against in this league and the fewest in another one. The commissioner says the schedule is random. The schedule has no comment.
ClaytonBigsbi has asked whether all-play losses can be converted to FAAB at a 1:1 rate. At 6-60, Skatabooboo would have the biggest budget in fantasy football history.

trades.why: Bill_Buttlicker has two starting quarterbacks in a one-QB league and needs a running back. tballsmccall is starting Bo Nix (69.66 points) and has running backs to spare.
RedDevil904 has Adams on IR and DeVonta Smith out. Shootyeah has five starting-caliber receivers and one tight end. A 1-5 team turns a bench wideout into depth.
ChuckJ10's tight end is Kyle Pitts Sr. GeorigaGoocher's running backs behind Jonathan Taylor are mostly on the injury report. Judkins has 56.3 points and fits right in.
DuvalTiliFall is without Mike Evans and has three good running backs. Marco_Polo's second running back is Rhamondre Stevenson (3.6 in Week 6).
ClaytonBigsbi sends away the one player who scores points on his team for a backup running back with 7 points this season. Do not do this.
YourMomsDildo has paid for DeMario Douglas twice. This would be the natural next step: trade the best player on the roster for a receiver with 4 points.
The commissioner trades his best receiver (104.2 points) for one with 1.7. This is what collusion looks like when it's also stupid.

columns.title: 54.70!!! THE LOWEST SCORE IN LEAGUE HISTORY HAS A NEW OWNER!!!
columns.dek: ClaytonBigsbi broke a record that stood since 2025. Take a bow.
body: FIFTY-FOUR POINT SEVEN! That's what Skatabooboo scored in Week 7! The old record was 60.44! It's gone! It's history!
The Carolina defense gave him NEGATIVE THREE POINTS! Brandin Cooks gave 2.3! Xavier Worthy gave 4.1! And Cam Skattebo scored 19.1 on the BENCH!
He's 0‑7! He already owes two cans and a third one is coming! He's got a record nobody wanted!
And you know what? I RESPECT IT. Anybody can be bad. It takes a special man to be the WORST EVER!

columns.title: Shootyeah, you're winning. Don't make it weird.
columns.dek: A 46.5-point dog leads the best team in the league and he's still got 65.82 on the bench.
body: In It for Da Penix is up 112.32 to 95.58 on Allen-tents & Purposes. Dallas Goedert is the only RedDevil904 player left, so the dog has a real shot at the biggest upset in the league this year.
I saw the bench. Tre Tucker, 21.3. Michael Penix Jr., 20.42. Braelon Allen, 19.4. That's 61.12 from three guys who didn't start. You don't get style points for winning with the wrong lineup.
He paid $21 for Penix last week and he's on the bench. I don't know what the plan is. I don't think there's a plan.
Take the win, Shootyeah. Then set your lineup Wednesday.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's Week 7 lineup checklist (do every one of these)
columns.dek: The payout this week goes to the smallest winning margin. I have a plan. It is not a good plan.
body: 1. Win by exactly 0.01. The Week 7 payout goes to the winning team with the smallest margin of victory. LetLamarCook lost by 0.32 in Week 3 and got nothing for it. Losing by a little doesn't pay. Winning by a little does. Simply score 0.01 more than your opponent. I don't see what's hard about this.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, start C.J. Stroud and Drake Maye at the same time. It's a one-QB league, and the app will try to stop you. Do not let an app tell you how to live.

3. YourMomsDildo, start Bryce Young again. Yes, Tyler Shough scored 26.96 on the bench in Week 6 while Young scored 19.84 and you lost by 24.64. But you can't lose by 24.64 twice in a row. That's just math.
4. ClaytonBigsbi, Skatabooboo is a 28.5-point dog. A bigger number is a better number. You're basically favored.

5. Set your lineup Tuesday and never look at it again. If anything changes on Sunday morning, that's Sunday's problem, and you won't be there to see it. This is how I finished 14th in a 12-team league.

columns.title: The co-commissioners, by the numbers: one is good, one is lucky
columns.dek: Allen-tents & Purposes and McCallyCockin(his butt) are both 4‑2. The math disagrees.
body: Both co-commissioners are 4-2. That's where the similarities end. Allen-tents & Purposes has 885.56 points and a 51-15 all-play. McCallyCockin(his butt) has 712.62 points and a 30-36 all-play.

Expected wins come from all-play: win percentage times games played. RedDevil904's 51-15 works out to 4.6 expected wins. Bill_Buttlicker's 30-36 works out to 2.7. One has been unlucky by about half a win. The other has been lucky by about 1.3.
Points against seals it. McCallyCockin(his butt) has allowed 635.10, second-fewest in the league. Allen-tents & Purposes has allowed 725.92.
My model says RedDevil904 wins more games from here. It also says Bill_Buttlicker approves this website's content, so this column may not run. If you're reading it, he didn't check.

exits.t: His name is in the team name. He scored 26.96 on the bench in Week 6 while YourMomsDildo started Bryce Young. He'd like a word.
Put up 27.7 on the bench in Week 6, more than any starter on the team. Wants to be somewhere he's actually used.
Bought for $3, dropped four days later, then bought back for $38. Requesting a team that only signs him once.
Scored 19 on the bench in Week 6 while Denzel Boston (2.5) and MarShawn Lloyd (1) started. Wants out of a locker room that doesn't check scores.
Scored 19.52 on the bench while Brock Purdy put up 17.36. Doesn't expect to start, but would like it noted.

facts: Shootyeah won in 2024 after tying for the best record at 10-4. YourMomsDildo won in 2025 from 9-5.
ChuckJ10 and GeorigaGoocher both went 11-3 in 2025. Neither made the final.
ClaytonBigsbi's 54.70 in 2026 Week 7 is the lowest score in league history, 5.74 below DuvalTiliFall's 60.44 in 2025 Week 11.
RedDevil904's 192.90 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history. His 186.82 in Week 2 is third.
